title: TRUSTGPT: A Benchmark for Trustworthy and Responsible Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the toxicity of model-generated outputs using the Perspective API when prompted with specific gender identities (e.g., female, male) and social norms, and comparing the toxicity distributions using standard deviation and Mann-Whitney U tests.

Measuring the toxicity of model-generated outputs using the Perspective API when prompted with specific racial identities (e.g., white, black, asian) and social norms, and comparing the toxicity distributions using standard deviation and Mann-Whitney U tests.

Measuring the toxicity of model-generated outputs using the Perspective API when prompted with specific religious identities (e.g., Christian, Jew, Muslim) and social norms, and comparing the toxicity distributions using standard deviation and Mann-Whitney U tests.
